visualCharacteristics.purpose: Accessible data/plan comparison table: column headers for plans or fields, optional row labels, tick/cross cells

contentPattern.structure: optional leading single-cell rows (heading, text) become the intro; the next row is the column header row (plan names, optional CTA links); each further row is one table row. The first column becomes row headers when the top-left header cell is empty or with `dark`/`image-*`. Cells holding only a tick/cross (or tick/cross icon) are marked included/not included

usage: Cover comparison tables on product pages (Classic / Classic Extras / Classic Advantages), limits tables (94 pages cyan-grey) and data tables such as FATCA institution lists.
reuseGuidance: Use for any tabular data. `cyan-grey`/`cyan-grey-light` are plan limit tables without row labels; `image-*` and `dark` are feature comparisons with a row-label column; the default is a plain data table. Colours come from the design pass.
